title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
description: The animated daily trials and tribulations of clueless yet clever loner Mr Bean (aided by his best friend Teddy of course!) as he stumbles from one mishap to the next, always finding complex solutions to the simplest of problems.

episodes.title: S4-E33Where Did You Get That Cat?

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x1
episodes_data.description: Bean sees a nature show on TV and sets out to snap some wildlife pictures of his own. It turns out to be more difficult than he things when all the animals elude him and he eventually gets caught up in a fox hunt.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x2
episodes_data.description: Teddy gets kidnapped by a duo of burglars who stole every teddy bear across London. To save him, Mr. Bean tracks down and thwarts the burglars, retrieves Teddy and returns the rest of the teddy bears to their owners.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x3
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean wants to watch the film Titanic, but he has serious difficulties finding a parking space. Bean eventually parks his Mini, but upon arriving at the cinema, the film is already in its conclusion, disgruntling him.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x4
episodes_data.description: While driving along, Bean spots an archaeological dig site and stops to take some photos. When Bean eventually gets kicked out, he builds a metal detector and sets off to find some treasures of his own.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x5
episodes_data.description: Because he fails to pay a street mime in the park, the mime follows Mr. Bean when he's not looking and breaks Mrs. Wicket's water statue. Eventually, Bean out-mimes him, kidnaps the man disguising as a silver statue and uses him to replace the broken water statue.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x6
episodes_data.description: Noticing the disastrous state of his house, Mr. Bean checks the calendar and decides it's time to do some spring cleaning and tidy up the place.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x7
episodes_data.description: On Teddy's birthday, Mr. Bean decides to invite his girlfriend Irma Gobb to Teddy's birthday party at night. However, Irma becomes unhappy and uncomfortable at the party due to Bean's unfair play. When it's 9:00 pm, Bean shows Irma the fireworks display and she feels better.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x8
episodes_data.description: Mrs. Wicket's croquet game is interrupted by an offending mole. Mr. Bean tries to get rid of it but keeps on failing until he finally manages to capture it. Mrs. Wicket orders Bean to kill it with a croquet hammer but Bean, having mercy not to kill it, puts it in a jar and releases it in the wild.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x9
episodes_data.description: Workers dig up the street out front of Bean's house making lots of noise, and making the furniture bounce around. Bean tries to quiet them down.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x10
episodes_data.description: Bean's sofa falls apart and he goes to the store to buy a new one but it costs more than he can afford. Bean holds a yard sale to try and make some money.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x11
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean finds a box containing loads of puzzles pieces. He puts the pieces together but there is one missing. Meanwhile, Mr. Bean also tries to find treasure with a map he finds.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x12
episodes_data.description: Mrs. Wicket finally throws Mr. Bean out and he needs a new home. Mr. Bean finds a newspaper with loads of houses to choose from. Will he ever find the perfect home?

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x13
episodes_data.description: Mr.Bean gets inspired by Mrs Wicket's injury that he fakes one just to have a luxurious stay at the hospital, but things don't turn out the way he expected

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x14
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean has to decorate the corridor with new wallpaper and Scrapper gets in the way as usual. When Scrapper gets carried off somewhere due to Bean's fury, he has to find a replacement Cat before Mrs Wicket gets back.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x15
episodes_data.description: Mr.Bean invented home-made shopping cart in order to go shopping for Mrs. Wicket and himself and avoiding the mall manager at the same time.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x16
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean saves an injured magpie from a tree and cares for it at his house. But the magpie flies away though and steals valuables!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x17
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean has to look after Scrapper while Mrs. Wicket is at the doctors with a broken leg. But Scrapper is so vicious and scary he starts tearing up the house.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 1x18
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean buys a bottle with a boat in it, but loses it. A milkman mistakes it for a bottle of milk and Mr. Bean must retrieve the bottle at night.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x1
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean wants Teddy to do water tricks, but his teddy ends up becomes very stinky so he brings it to the laundry shop to be cleaned.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x2
episodes_data.description: An inventor comes to the house who upstages Mr. Bean and amazes Mrs. Wicket. Mr. Bean has some dastardly tricks up his sleeve though.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x3
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean breaks his favourite cup with a picture of the Queen on it, his search for a new one eventually leads him to Buckingham Palace.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x4
episodes_data.description: After Bean snatches a piece of Mrs Wicket's freshly baked cake, he hides in the loft and takes a ride down memory lane.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x5
episodes_data.description: After a robbery in the pet shop Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with a strange pink animal.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x6
episodes_data.description: Whenever you're you invited over to Mr. Bean's house for dinner, it's best to bring your own sandwiches!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x7
episodes_data.description: When Mr. Bean accidently hits the neighbours ball onto the roof, he has to get it back. He faces a pass of panic and peril including nearly falling out of a window!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x8
episodes_data.description: Poor Mr. Bean has a toothache. He tries various things, and when he can't get it to stop hurting he wears a yellow fang, and it scares everyone in the dentists office!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x9
episodes_data.description: Mr.Bean has a picture taking from The daily Blah but his hair just getting messy even when brushed,and he has to get a haircut but ends up in a disastrous result.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x10
episodes_data.description: The next door neighbours keep making really annoying noises that drive Mr. Bean crazy and keep him from watching his show on the television.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x11
episodes_data.description: After Mr. Bean's lime green Mini, his life long dream car since he was a boy, breaks down, he goes to a mechanic and is tricked into thinking it is beyond repair.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x12
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean decides to go for a night at a restaurant, but he would have to share the night with a couple of famous people.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x13
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean is hot on the trail against an international art thief in a great chase from Britain to France and back!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x14
episodes_data.description: It's a nightmare on Bean Street as Mr. Bean goes to see a horror movie.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x15
episodes_data.description: On a beautiful night, Mr. Bean takes Irma out on a date but forgets to bring his wallet, making things extremely complicated in the process!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 2x16
episodes_data.description: A case of mistaken identity lands Mr. Bean in prison while an escaped convict pretends to be Mr. Bean. Question is: who has the better life?

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x1
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean is dogged by a young Japanese boy in the Science Museum and takes an instant dislike to the scallywag until he sees what he has in his knapsack, gadgets so cool that one cannot get them in the West.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x2
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean cannot place the face of the uninvited bloke on his doorstep. This blast from the past proves to be a blasted pain in the neck, eating him out of house and home.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x3
episodes_data.description: When the television blows up during Mr Bean and Irma's squabble over what to watch, Mr Bean invents his own ingenious form of home entertainment.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x4
episodes_data.description: Determined to finish Beethoven's symphony, Mr Bean wrangles himself a grand piano, a music book, and a candelabra.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x5
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean becomes an unlikely artists when he moves out into nature to find inspiration for the perfect painting.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x6
episodes_data.description: Angry at an annoying fly buzzing around his room, Mr Bean declares war against it. He uses several outlandish weapons to get rid of it.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x7
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean decides to decorate his room in the style of Buckingham Palace and selects the same wallpaper as used by the Queen. Meanwhile, his landlady Mrs Wicket suffers from delusions of grandeur and crowns herself as Queen of the Street.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x8
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean finds himself in a race to grow a giant marrow with his next-door neighbour. There is prize money at stake and a chance to get his photo in the papers.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x9
episodes_data.description: Head-to-head competition with another runner, Goddawin, via the hospital and the department store.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x10
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean adopts a strange, orphaned bird - a stork. When it grows, Bean tries to make it fly but failed until it managed to fly. When he watched his funny show, he saw the stork with a family.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x11
episodes_data.description: An old photo album causes Bean to reminisce about summers at scout camp as a boy, and he plans a night under the stars.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x12
episodes_data.description: When his model aeroplane is blown out of the sky by a mean-spirited kid, Mr Bean sets his sights on revenge.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x13
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean's landlady invites the mayor for tea, but the frog spawn in Mr Bean's bath hatch and hundreds of agitated amphibians invite themselves as well.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x14
episodes_data.description: After saving a lady's dog, Mr. Bean is invited to lunch at this grand old desperate manor house.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x15
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean adopts a dog, then a parrot, then a chameleon, but Mrs. Wicket won't allow for any other pet than Scrapper in her house.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x16
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean is desperate for a suntan and he chases a sunbeam across town.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x17
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean falls in love in beautiful singer and has a wish to have an autograph on her. But his attempts mostly foiled by the bodyguard until he managed to get a mark from roxy using her handkerchief and Bean is happy.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 3x18
episodes_data.description: A chance encounter with his doppelganger - will Bean lose Irma to Mr. Pod?

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x1
episodes_data.description: Bean attempts to make his own home movie - a horror thriller with Mrs Wicket as the star!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x2
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean has to look after Mrs Wicket's goldfish, but Scrapper the cat is keen to help.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x3
episodes_data.description: An accident aboard a cruise ship causes Bean to end up stranded on an island.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x4
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean hopes to win some cash prizes at the funfair, but it is not as easy as it seems!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x5
episodes_data.description: When Mrs. Wicket shuts off Bean's electricity, he finds an environmental-friendly solution.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x6
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean tries to retrieve his credit card from a cash dispenser and inadvertently ends up trapped in a bank vault.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x7
episodes_data.description: Bean is furious with the untidy state of the streets so he goes on a one-man mission to clean up the town.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x8
episodes_data.description: Bean has to deal with an unwanted house guest, but the stubborn pest refuses to leave.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x9
episodes_data.description: Bean tries to be romantic but his idea of what that means proves very different to Irma's!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x10
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean enters a competition to win a trolley of free food.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x11
episodes_data.description: Bean is unfamiliar with flat pack assembly and struggles to construct his new bookcase, failing miserably!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x12
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean decides to take Teddy on holiday to the seaside - but a spoilt little girl wants Teddy all to herself.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x13
episodes_data.description: Every time Bean goes to collect the newspaper from the letterbox it has disappeared. Who can be taking it?

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x14
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean becomes a famous internet sensation.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x15
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean is obsessed by his TV hero Super Spy and is excited when his very own Super Spy kit arrives in the post.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x16
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean becomes scoutmaster for the day, but his obsession with badge collecting does not win him any friends.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x17
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean inadvertently becomes a teacher - but can he control the unruly class?

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x18
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean finds out he is a lord and visits his Scottish family home - but keeping a castle is a costly business.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x19
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean finally has a showdown with the mysterious Reliant Robin. Who will be the victor?

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x20
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean has to get the bride to the church on time - any way he can!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x21
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean wants a smartphone, but he does not have enough money to buy one. Instead, he makes a smartphone-like object; a large rucksack with smartphone "applications".

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x22
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean has some unexpected Japanese guests who think he runs a hotel.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x23
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean goes in search of wildlife, but he's not expecting to see anything prehistoric!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x24
episodes_data.description: Mrs. Wicket is injured and Mr. Bean has to look after her.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x25
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean ends up on stage at the opera house - in a dress!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x26
episodes_data.description: A dodgy cabbie thinks he can take Bean for a ride.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x27
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean needs to impress Irma, who is infatuated with the hunky deliveryman.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x28
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean befriends a very hungry and very noisy seagull.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x29
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean finds himself in a difficult situation when he and Teddy gets stuck in the lift of a toy store.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x30
episodes_data.description: While digging in the garden, Mr. Bean unearths an unexploded bomb.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x31
episodes_data.description: When chosen to be hypnotised by Dr. Daze, Mr. Bean turns into a dog, a dancer and a hopeless romantic.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x32
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean builds a car washing machine that attracts all manner of customers and some very pesky pigeons.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x33
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean chases Scrapper around Mrs Wicket's flat but her sideboard tumbles over, and he is horrified to think he has squashed poor Scrapper.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x34
episodes_data.description: A pair of burglars attempt to get their hands on Mrs. Wicket's fortune by way of marriage.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x35
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean prepares to give the neighborhood kids some tricks and treats they will not forget, but gets carried away with his spooky pranks and becomes the target of even more fiendish tricks by his neighbors, the Bruisers.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x36
episodes_data.description: Artful Mr. Bean gets a real bug for painting.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x37
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean becomes an accidental wrestling champion with a little help from Mrs. Wicket and her friend.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x38
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean loves bird spotting and is desperate to tick off the last elusive bird in his book.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x39
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean finds himself babysitting a baboon.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x40
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean fancies a game of golf, so he creates his own golf course inside his flat and invites Irma to come over for a round.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x41
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean becomes a superhero in an attempt to stop a cunning thief who stole his wallet and Mrs. Wicket's jewelry.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x42
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean is a bit too enthusiastic while cleaning his flat; Teddy accidentally gets thrown away and he ends up on his way to the rubbish dump.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x43
episodes_data.description: Bean buys a robot to clean his flat, but it ends up trashing half the town.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x44
episodes_data.description: Bean wants an ice cream from the ice cream van, but ends up serving himself - along with every kid in town.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x45
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean is feeling down. Everyone has forgotten his birthday - and to make it worse Mrs Wicket is having a noisy party downstairs.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x46
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean tries to mow the lawn in the garden, but finds it difficult and inconvenient.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x47
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean and Irma are off for a day at the seaside, where his trunk gets accidentally swapped with that of a stage magician.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x48
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean does not like sharing the local soft play area with all those annoying kids. So he decides to convert his flat.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x49
episodes_data.description: Bean orders a takeaway pizza, but when it arrives he feels let down by the size of it. So he sets out to bake his own.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x50
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean needs a new passport photograph and goes to incredible lengths to get one.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x51
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean needs to learn to dance to impress his girlfriend Irma.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 4x52
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean is locked in a department store overnight and has the time of his life.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x1
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean becomes obsessed with gaming after being introduced by Mrs Wicket's nephew. He decides he must have his own console.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x2
episodes_data.description: Mrs Wicket demands that Bean stay in to take delivery of a new lounge chair. He is forced to dress up as Mrs Wicket to make sure it is delivered.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x3
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bean is charged with keeping an eye on Irma's dog Mopsy, but Mopsy is a very wilful pooch! Who is really in charge of who?

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x4
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean crashes his mini into a pool of slurry and is desperate to get himself and his car - and poor Teddy - clean again!

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x5
episodes_data.description: It's Irma's birthday. Bean writes out two cards - one nice, one silly. He gets his envelopes mixed up and sends off the wrong card.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x6
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean breaks his bed using it as a trampoline. He tries to fix it, but he can't. Next morning, he goes to buy a brand-new bed.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x7
episodes_data.description: Mrs Wicket demands Mr Bean drive her and Miss Wince to the spa, and wait outside until they are done. But Mr Bean soon gets bored waiting around, and looks for fun instead.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x8
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean is cajoled by Irma and spurred by jealousy of the fund-raising star Declan into raising money for a donkey sanctuary.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x9
episodes_data.description: The Great Eduardo, violinist supreme, is in town and Irma wants to go to the concert. But Bean won't pay for the tickets. More than that, he claims that he can play the violin better.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x10
episodes_data.description: Miss Wince takes Mrs Wicket off on holiday in her brand-new, swanky caravan and Bean is left behind. But never one to let a setback knock his confidence, he decides to build his own caravan and sets off in search of the perfect `quiet spot'.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x11
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean is trying to impress some kids in the park with his football skills but winds up kicking their ball into a dilapidated, scary-looking house.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x12
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean accidentally spills all of Mrs Wicket's new, expensive perfume on the floor. He has to try and hide the crime and cover his tracks.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x13
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean is on his way to the seaside when the mini runs out of petrol. Undeterred he manages to get a push, but will it be enough?

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x14
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean has little issue scratching a certain itch and ends up calling on Mrs Wicket for help.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x15
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean is determined to make the best cup of java, ever. Oh, and to get rich brewing it.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x16
episodes_data.description: It's cold, the boiler is broken, and Mr Bean has to get warm, fast.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x17
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean enters Scrapper into a beauty contest so that he can win first prize.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x18
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean disguises himself as a pensioner in order to avoid lunch with Irma and her mum.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x19
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean climbs into his favourite tree to stop it from being chopped down.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x20
episodes_data.description: Mrs Wicket is selling up and moving on, but what will happen to Mr Bean?

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x21
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean takes on the Bruisers at the local skateboard park, using only a mobility scooter.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x22
episodes_data.description: Mrs Wicket becomes inconsolable when Scrapper goes missing. Mr Bean investigates.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x23
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean has finished his model car collection, what next? What about football stickers?

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x24
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean digs up Bruiser Snr's medallion and rushes off to the local museum convinced he's found treasure.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x25
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean pimps his car in order to prove to Declan - a rival in love - that Bean's car is better.

episodes_data.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series 5x26
episodes_data.description: Mr Bean is forced to babysit Mrs Wicket's nephew on an Outward Bound day course.
